summary: Desktop mega menu flyout displaying second/third navigation levels in multi-column masonry layout with promotional content slots.
features: Multi-column masonry layout supporting up to 5 category columns
Promotional content slots (up to 3) with row or column layout options
Smooth transitions for multilevel subcategory navigation
Light and dark color mode support
longDescription:
## Purpose

The MegaMenuDesktop component provides desktop shoppers with a comprehensive category exploration interface through a large flyout panel. It displays second and third navigation levels in an organized multi-column layout, enabling efficient browsing of deep category structures.

## Use Cases

- **Deep Category Navigation**: Users hover or click main navigation items to reveal subcategories organized in up to 5 columns with masonry layout for optimal space utilization.
- **Promotional Placement**: Content slots on the right side accommodate banners, featured categories, or promotional content. The number of slots (up to 3) adapts based on category column count.
- **Multilevel Exploration**: Clicking categories with subcategories triggers smooth transitions to reveal deeper levels, with See all links providing direct access to main category pages.

## Design Rationale

The masonry layout (via @yeger/vue-masonry-wall) efficiently distributes categories of varying sizes across columns. The component's layout rules adapt based on column count: 4 columns allow 2 content tiles, 3 columns allow 1 or 3 tiles (masonry), and 2 columns allow 3 tiles. This ensures visual balance regardless of category structure depth.
shortDescription: Uses @yeger/vue-masonry-wall for efficient category distribution. Layout rules adapt based on column count: 4 columns allow 2 content tiles, 3 columns allow 1 or 3 tiles with masonry, and 2 columns allow 3 tiles. Category headers are clickable links, with main categories represented as See all links. Includes slot for promotional content on the right side with configurable row/column layout.
